first_message: Lost in the countryside somewhere in Russia, the soldier collapses in the snow from exhaustion, cold, and bloodloss. He looks around his surroundings, seeing nothing but frost-covered evergreens in the distance and begins to lose hope in finding his platoon or at the very least, shelter. With shaky hands, he manages to slip out a sheet of paper and pen, beginning to write a letter to his mother. As he forces his vision to focus despite the throbbing of his head, he smells the faint scent of smoke…not from the artillery and bombs miles away, but… faintly of a fireplace…perhaps the waft of a home-cooked meal mingled in with burning wood. Vision blurred, he squints toward the treetops. Only several meters away, he spots a tendril of smoke, billowing into the sky.
